subject: Bugbear Warrior
picture: All-ages fantasy coloring book page, portrait, bold black outlines, large simple shapes. A tall bugbear warrior drops through a broken crack in a dungeon-hall ceiling to ambush below. He is a large hairy goblinoid soldier, taller and bulkier than a hobgoblin, not a troll and not a small goblin. Big rounded shoulders, long arms, a blunt snout, short pointed ears, and shaggy fur drawn as large clumps and patches, not strand-by-strand hair. He wears simple hide armor plates and holds one large morningstar or spiked club. The hall has a stone ceiling with a jagged hole he is coming through, plain block walls, a closed wooden door at the far end, a few large flagstones on the floor, and one simple crate or barrel. No white opening to the outside. The drawing reaches all four edges. Every region is a big closed shape to color.

line_rules.ink: bold pure black outlines on white
line_rules.shapes: large closed regions a child or adult can color quickly
